question: May a rebind onto a member-template PDB spelling (??$Name@<T>@Q@@...) be accepted when objgate differs only in .drectve, which gains VC7.1's own `/alternatename:<??$ symbol>=<old-style mangling>` token for that callee (verdict ALL_EQ_TPLALT)?
evidence: 29 rows, all in tplalt_hold/ (ready: every gate passed, TABLE_CHANGES finalized to land after b4; locks released): GetSubDef<T>, GetComponent<T>, GFSerialiseMap*<...>. Precedent: the landed row 0x006CA4E0 (its HEAD object, compiled with VC7.1) carries the same token, `/alternatename:??$GetSubDef@VCHeroDef@@@CDefClassBase@@QBE_NPAV?$CDefPointer@$$CBVCHeroDef@@@@@Z=?GetSubDef@CDefClassBase@@QBE_NPAV?$CDefPointer@$$CBVCHeroDef@@@@@Z`. Every other section, every relocation, the DEF set and the UND delta are equal (old -> new). VC7.1 emits this token for every function-template specialization a TU references; nothing in the source asks for it. Link gate PASS (the definers define the ??$ names), vland PASS, name_gate no worse.
proposal: yes: treat the added token as part of the callee rename; then land tplalt_hold as a batch after b4 (flip its RESULTS verdicts to ACCEPT)

question: May a callee-only rebind drop the row's local BODY of the stand-in (a template or inline method the row defines only to model the callee) when the call moves to the PDB spelling?
evidence: 107 residue lines "stand-in has a body in the row" (mostly GetSubDef<T> rows that define `template <class T> __declspec(noinline) bool CDefClassBase::GetSubDef(CDefPointer<T>&)` locally). The object then loses that stand-in COMDAT DEF, so objgate's DEF-set check fails by exactly that symbol.
proposal: yes if the dropped DEF is exactly the stand-in symbol renamed away and the leaf bytes are unchanged; otherwise these stay with the header port
